examples.english: Today, Grandpa and his granddaughter went to the shop.
examples.transliteration: El naharda geddo w bento raho el mahal.

examples.arabic: جدو وتيتا بيحبوا البيت الهادي قوي
examples.english: Grandpa and Grandma really love the quiet house.
examples.transliteration: Gido w teta be7ebu el beet el hady awi.

examples.arabic: جدو وتيتا كانوا بيتكلموا عن زمان وحكايات كتير
examples.english: Grandpa and Grandma were talking about old times and many stories.
examples.transliteration: Geddo w Teta kanoo biyetkallimoo 3an zamaan w hekayat kteer.

examples.arabic: هو بيسأل ايه ده يا جدو
examples.transliteration: howa biyisa'al eh da ya geddo
